question: Reconcile yesterday's USD settlement account. Which breaks are still open?

answer.question: Reconcile yesterday's USD settlement account. Which breaks are still open?
answer.answer:
Four breaks are still open on the USD settlement account WGB-SETTLE-USD-01 for value date Mar 11, 2026. Of 240 statement items, 236 matched (98.3%).

| Break | Type | Delta (USD) | Reference |
|---|---|---|---|
| BRK-01 | Amount mismatch | +1,250.00 | PAY-2987 |
| BRK-02 | Missing on internal ledger | -18,400.00 | Statement line 118 |
| BRK-03 | Missing on bank statement | +7,615.50 | PAY-3011 |
| BRK-04 | Amount mismatch | -312.40 | PAY-3046 |

Net difference is -9,846.90, and gross break value is 27,577.90.

BRK-02 is the largest and should be worked first. Any proposed adjustments are drafts only, and no ledger entry has been posted.
